outcome_blind_attestation.note: gate consumed decision instants, target books, fill-price cost inputs, funding cadence and declared cost parameters only

floor_table_frozen.definition: scheduled discretionary rebalance decisions normalised to a 365-day equivalent window must not exceed 60
median completed intended holding span (calendar days, from target-book occupancy) must be at least 3
annualised transition cost at the declared cost floor, divided by average gross capital, must not exceed 0.08
annualised transition cost under fee x1.5 and +2 adverse ticks, divided by average gross capital, must not exceed 0.12
no single symbol may contribute more than 25% of total one-way turnover (sum of absolute target deltas)

annualised_base_cost_drag_frac_of_gross.definition: annualised base cost drag as a fraction of average gross capital, using the declared cost floors via the adapter cost function

annualised_base_cost_drag_frac_of_gross_.definition: total transition cost over the window under stress 'baseline' (capital-weight units, adapter cost arithmetic)

annualised_stressed_cost_drag_frac_of_gr.definition: annualised cost drag as a fraction of average gross capital under the frozen fee x1.5 / +2-tick stressed cell, via the adapter cost function
total transition cost over the window under stress 'stress_fee_x1_5_plus_2_ticks' (capital-weight units, adapter cost arithmetic)

average_gross_capital.definition: mean target-book gross capital (sum of absolute weights) over all scheduled decision instants

censored_open_span_count.definition: intended holding spans still open at the last scheduled instant; excluded from duration statistics and never silently closed

completed_holding_span_count.definition: intended holding spans closed by the schedule (symbol weight is zero again at a scheduled decision)

decisions_per_365d.definition: discretionary decisions normalised to a 365-day equivalent: n_discretionary * 365 / window_days

discretionary_decision_count.definition: scheduled discretionary rebalance decisions (risk/terminal forced-flat actions counted separately)

forced_flat_decision_count.definition: risk/terminal forced-flat actions, reported separately from discretionary decisions and excluded from the per-365d floor

funding_events_per_365d.definition: funding events while held normalised to a 365-day equivalent

funding_events_while_held_total.definition: count of native settlement events falling inside intended holding spans (cadence only; no rate is applied)

max_intended_holding_days.definition: maximum completed intended holding span in calendar days

max_symbol_turnover_share.definition: largest single-symbol share of total one-way turnover

max_symbol_turnover_share_symbol.definition: symbol holding the largest turnover share

median_intended_holding_days.definition: median completed intended holding span in calendar days

one_way_turnover_discretionary.definition: one-way turnover (sum of absolute target deltas, capital-weight units) across transitions into discretionary books, including the initial entry from flat

one_way_turnover_forced_flat.definition: one-way turnover across transitions into forced-flat books, reported separately from discretionary turnover

one_way_turnover_total.definition: total one-way turnover: discretionary plus forced-flat transitions

per_symbol_turnover_share.definition: per-symbol share of total one-way turnover

signal_availability_fraction.definition: fraction of scheduled decision instants where the proposed signal was available

signal_missing_instant_count.definition: count of scheduled instants where the proposed signal was unavailable

signal_missing_instants.definition: scheduled instants where the proposed signal was unavailable

window_days.definition: scheduled window length in calendar days (last decision instant minus first, normalised by one day)

outcome_blind_attestation.explanation: every metric derives from decision instants, target books, fill-price cost inputs, funding cadence and declared cost parameters; the gate computes and exposes no scored capital path of any candidate
